common_assumptions: Style enforcement rules are fully specified and require no additional context
File paths and directory structures match expected locations without verification
Build success or typecheck-pass implies runtime correctness
Task scope is fully defined from the prompt alone
Prior session state is as expected without re-reading
strength_patterns: Systematic probe-then-act tool sequencing in multi-step investigation tasks
Thorough verification steps in audit chains (fingerprint validation, config diffing, test runs)
Targeted file reads before edits to confirm structure before modifying
weakness_patterns: Repetitive access to the same files in large editing chains without measurable forward progress (fixation in layout/page components)
Direct single-step responses on bounded tasks with no alternative consideration or edge-case exploration
Treating build-green or typecheck-pass as runtime verification without exercising actual code paths
